issues.on_page: Operating expenses of an irrigation district (Contract labor ... Water advance to Bureau)
issues.issue: Function judgment call: the disbursement rules list water and drainage districts under natural resources/conservation, and the extractor already used that category for Weed control. All 16 other operating expense lines (disbursements[0]-[15]) are under utilities. This is defensible (the district delivers irrigation water for tolls) but the report is categorized inconsistently.
